[Marubeni Corporation](https://www.marubeni.com/en/) is a major Japanese **sōgō shōsha** (general trading and investment company). Headquartered in Tokyo, it operates as a massive global conglomerate involved in domestic trade, international import/export, project management, and business investments across many different industries. [](https://baike.baidu.com/en/item/MARUBENI%20CORPORATION/1417848)

Marubeni handles a vast array of goods, resources, and services through specialized divisions:

- **Food and Agribusiness:** Trading grain, food, and agricultural products.

- **Energy and Chemicals:** Handling crude oil, gas, and petrochemicals.

- **Metals and Mineral Resources:** Sourcing iron, coal, and other raw materials.

- **Power and Infrastructure:** Developing power plants, renewable energy, and water projects.

- **Aerospace and Mobility:** Managing aircraft leasing, ships, and automotive financing.

- **Lifestyle and Real Estate:** Overseeing apparel supply chains, consumer goods, and housing developments. [](https://www.marubeni.com/en/ir/individual/number/)
